sections.heading: State PSC document requirements vary by portal.
body: State Public Service Commissions each maintain distinct Online Application Systems (OTR/OAS). Document upload caps vary from 100 KB to 500 KB depending on the specific state and recruitment post.
Check your specific notification details below or select an exact file target KB tool to compress your certificates instantly.

faq.q: How do I compress my State PSC application PDF?
faq.a: Select the target KB size specified in your state PSC notification (100 KB, 200 KB, 300 KB, or 500 KB) and use Zcompressor to resize your PDF in seconds.
